maria (AE): PulseHealth asked for a short acceptance run and cost note: sustain 120 qps with p99 <350ms, support 3x 2m bursts to 800 qps, KMS in the path, and audit logs. Can we run Tue?

sam (SE): Yup. Plan: 30m soak @120 qps, then three 2-minute bursts to 800 qps spaced 5m. Compare baseline fp32 vs 4-bit quant + KV prefix cache. Capture p50/p95/p99, kernel fallback counts, GPU util, host queue depth, and KMS call latencies.

linh (SRE): Flag: concurrent KMS decrypts have caused tail spikes previously. Ask PulseHealth whether TLS is terminated upstream or passed through. If upstream ALB terminates TLS we get extra copy/CPU.

zoe (ops): I'll provision a temporary pool: 4xA100 + 1 standby, batching target=16, conservative concurrency. Will open loadgen whitelist and enable nvidia/host metrics.

deploy-bot: provision: pool-pulse-4781 started, ETA 11m.

sam (SE): Repro commands to include in runbook:
hey -z 30m -q 120 -c 250 -m POST -d '{"prompt":"<redacted>"}' https://staging-api.redwood/v1/generate
for i in 1 2 3; do hey -z 2m -q 800 -c 1000 -m POST -d '{"prompt":"x"}' https://staging-api.redwood/v1/generate; sleep 300; done

sam (SE): Quick post-run summary: fp32 baseline p99 ~275ms without KMS. With KMS enabled p99 rose to ~330-380ms with occasional spikes. Quantized variant steady p99 ~460ms; during 800 qps bursts quant p99 hit ~610ms due to kernel fallback and host queueing. GPU util steady ~70% -> peak ~95%.

linh (SRE): Traces show KMS decrypt bursts correlate with proxy thread saturation. Short-term mitigation: pre-warm tokens and increase proxy worker threads; that reduced p99 by ~8-12ms. Long-term: async decrypt off hot path or HSM-backed flow.

maria (AE): Sales asks for cost bullets: monthly Dedicated reserved for pool, prorated test window, hosted burst charge per peak-qps-minute, and token-cost delta.

sam (SE): Draft numbers (for discussion): Dedicated 4xA100 pool ~$9,200/month; prorated 4h test ~$1,100. Hosted burst approx $0.095/peak-qps-minute -> single 2m 800-qps burst ~ $152. Token costs: baseline effective $0.018/token-equivalent; quant raw saves ~18% -> $0.0147, net after infra overhead ~12% savings.

zoe (ops): Security blockers noted: HSM requirement, key custody details, audit log retention windows, and canary rollback policy.

linh (SRE): I'll draft security answers and a canary recipe: 5% -> 25% -> 100% rollout with health checks and automated fallback if p99 > 500ms for 10m.

maria (AE): Next steps: sam upload 1-page runbook + CSV/plots, zoe finalize cost/prorate, linh post security draft by EOD. I'll present the acceptance matrix to PulseHealth on Wed 9am PT.

sam (SE): Will upload artifacts in this thread shortly. TL;DR numbers: fp32 p99=275ms, quant steady p99=460ms, quant burst p99~610ms, net token savings ~12%.

maria (AE): Thanks team :thumbsup:
